text:
liam.pm: Starting a focused thread to capture a lightweight outreach + acceptance checklist for the design-partner pilot. Need something sales/solutions can use without heavy edits.

anya-cs: Suggest we split into 3 docs: 1) recruiter outreach script + screening checklist, 2) technical intake + acceptance criteria, 3) partner incentives & legal bullets. Short and copyable.

frank-se: For technical intake, mandatory items: sandbox API hit, tracing header present, tokenization parity check, and a small replay of 500 sample requests. If they can't run the replay, mark as "needs engineering support".

nora-research: Add a data-sharing permission flag: can we use anonymized prompts for A/B testing? yes/no. Partners who say yes get prioritized for feature experiments.

maya-ops: On incentives: 12 weeks free Dedicated-lite or $5k platform credit. also offer one integration day of SE time included. Keep terms simple to avoid legal churn.

liam.pm: Good. Candidate scoring: ProductFit (0-5), ExpectedVolume (0-5), OpsLift (0-5 inverted), ExperimentGoodwill (+1 if willing to share prompts). Require average >=3.2 to qualify.

anya-cs: Screening call template (short):
- What LLM use-case and key success metric?
- Typical request/per-minute and peak concurrency?
- Expected p95 latency target?
- Can you run a small harness or accept a remote test?
- Any regulatory or residency constraints?

frank-se: I'll upload a tiny harness (Node + curl examples) that replays 500 requests and emits a simple pass/fail trace. Will also include a config for requiring trace-id header.

nora-research: For feedback cadence: wave1 = weekly 30m + shared Notion board + fortnightly eval snapshots; wave2/3 = biweekly 30m. Collect qualitative notes in the board and a short exit survey.

maya-ops: Onboarding fast-path checklist for low-friction partners: 1) service account + whitelist IPs 2) sample traffic shape provided 3) test harness executed 4) legal thumbs-up. Fast-path gets 2-day SLA for sandbox access.

liam.pm: Exit criteria to graduate from pilot to public beta: at least 6 partners complete acceptance, overall quality drift <=4%, latency SLO met for 80% of partners, and one public case study or testimonial secured (opt-in).

anya-cs: Scope guard: no custom model training or offline dataset ingestion during pilot unless separately contracted. We can do small inference config tweaks (quantization/engine flags) if partner agrees.

frank-se: Agreed. Also log any engineering time > 8 hours per partner as "chargeable" and surface during scoping.

nora-research: I'll draft a 6-question exit survey: NPS, top 3 pain points, feature asks (ranked), perceived performance, integration ease, willingness to convert.

maya-ops: Ops requests: put a toggle in the onboarding doc for "require VPN/VPC" so SEs know to route to Private team early.

deploy-bot: infra: onboarding-checklist v1.1 published to /internal/playbooks/onboarding (audit: ob-4692).

liam.pm: Next steps: Anya — recruiter script + outreach copy by EOD. Frank — harness and short README by tomorrow noon. Nora — exit survey draft by Thursday. Maya — fast-path checklist into Playbooks today. I'll stitch into one partner packet once we have drafts.

anya-cs: On it.

frank-se: Will push harness to shared drive.

nora-research: Drafting now.

maya-ops: Adding checklist.

liam.pm: If no objections, i'll post the consolidated packet in #pm-announce Friday morning for wider ops/solutions feedback.

anya-cs: lgtm

frank-se: lgtm

maya-ops: lgtm :thumbsup:

liam.pm: Thanks team!"
